domain_restrictions: n is an integer and n > 1
k is an integer with 1 <= k <= n
the floor function is applied to the real number k*t
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all integers n greater than 1 and all real numbers t, if for all integers k with 1 <= k <= n the floor of k times t equals k minus 1, then E_n of t equals H_n minus 1.
quantifier_order: for every integer k (within 1 <= k <= n)

variables.name: k
variables.role: bound ranging variable in the condition, restricted by 1 <= k <= n

statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every real number t, if floor(k*t) = k-1 for every integer k with 1 <= k <= n, then E_n(t) = H_n - 1.
